changeSet.author: thonbecker
changeSet.comment: Record which calendar holds each mapped event. Existing rows point at the retired OpenCloud collection, so deletion sync must never read them as missing Google events.

changeSet.author: thonbecker
changeSet.comment: Reopen the calendar listener's BookingCreatedEvent publication for each upcoming booking that is mapped only to OpenCloud. Spring Modulith republishes incomplete publications on restart, and the publication belongs to the calendar listener only, so the replay creates the Google event without a second confirmation email.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE event_publication p SET completion_date = NULL, status = 'FAILED' FROM booking.calendar_event_mappings m JOIN booking.bookings b ON b.id = m.booking_id WHERE p.event_type = 'biz.thonbecker.personal.booking.api.BookingCreatedEvent' AND p.listener_id LIKE 'biz.thonbecker.personal.calendar.platform.CalendarEventListener.onBookingCreated%' AND p.completion_date IS NOT NULL AND m.calendar_provider = 'OPENCLOUD' AND b.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') AND b.end_time > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AND substring(p.serialized_event FROM '"bookingId"\s*:\s*(\d+)')::bigint = m.booking_id
